attr.title: Toziuha Night: Order of the Alchemists
attr.desc: This is the story of Xandria, an iron alchemist. She seeks revenge regardless of the consequences. To achieve it, Xandria fights with a powerful whip and the power of chemical elements. Find out more about her in this modern metroidvania adventure.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Itch.io, gog or steam, download and extract the tn_oota.pck into the gamedata folder. When you first start the game, it will ask if you want to configure the controls. This menu can only be used with a touchscreen. Therefore, if you do not have a touchscreen, you must force the game to close and re-enter, and the menu will not reappear.
attr.inst_md:
Purchase the game on Itch.io, gog or steam, download and extract the tn_oota.pck into the gamedata folder.
Buy links here:
[https://dannygaray60.github.io/tn-oota.html](https://dannygaray60.github.io/tn-oota.html)
When you first start the game, it will ask if you want to configure the controls. This menu can only be used with a touchscreen. Therefore, if you do not have a touchscreen, you must force the game to close and re-enter, and the menu will not reappear.
